page_title: MET 1-3 AUX | Metz v Auxerre 15/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' 1 - 3 Goal! Alpha Toure pulls the ball back for Nathan Mbala (Metz) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike into the top right corner. 1:3.
90+3' Nathan Mbala (Metz) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
90+3' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.
90+1' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) sees a yellow card from Marc Bollengier after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90+1' The manager makes a subsitution with Yvan Zaddy (Auxerre) coming on for Kevin Danois.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

90' 0 - 3 Goal! Kevin Danois (Auxerre) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top right corner. Jonathan Fischer had no chance of reaching it. The score is 0:3.
89' Giorgi Kvilitaia (Metz) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Donovan Leon and he's equal to it.
88' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
87' Ball possession – 63:37.
85' Corner kick. Metz will have an opportunity.
85' The goal by Auxerre is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
85' The Auxerre players joy may have been justified, because referee Marc Bollengier is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
85' The foul by Assane Diousse (Auxerre) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Marc Bollengier.
83' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
82' Here comes a substitution. Giorgi Abuashvili is given a rest as he is replaced by Nathan Mbala (Metz).
82' Christophe Pelissier has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Assane Diousse (Auxerre) replacing Naouirou Ahamada.
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Lamine Sy will be replaced by Marvin Senaya (Auxerre).
81' Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
78' Marc Bollengier shows a yellow card to Josue Casimir (Auxerre) for a tough tackle.
76' 0 - 2 It's an own goal! Urie-Michel Mboula (Metz) unluckily beats his own goalkeeper.
72' Romain Faivre goes off the pitch and Lasso Coulibaly (Auxerre) comes on.
72' Here is a change. Sekou Mara is going off and Christophe Pelissier gives the last tactical orders to Josue Casimir (Auxerre).
72' Auxerre are ruled offside.
71' Sekou Mara (Auxerre) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Jonathan Fischer.
70' Here comes a substitution. Giorgi Kvilitaia (Metz) is brought on as a substitute for Gauthier Hein.
70' Alpha Toure (Metz) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
69' Naouirou Ahamada (Auxerre) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar.
68' Auxerre concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
65' A yellow card for a tackle by Lucas Michal (Metz). Marc Bollengier doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
65' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
63' Benoit Tavenot decides to make a substitution. Koffi Kouao will be replaced by Maxime Colin (Metz).
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fode Ballo-Toure trots off the pitch and is replaced by Lucas Michal (Metz).
61' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
59' The ball falls kindly for Lamine Sy (Auxerre) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just wide of the left post.
59' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
58' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
58' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Sekou Mara (Auxerre) inside the box. Auxerre win a corner.
57' Clement Akpa (Auxerre) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
55' Alpha Toure (Metz) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
54' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Jonathan Fischer makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
52' Flag goes up against Naouirou Ahamada (Auxerre) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
50' The ball goes out of play and Metz have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Koffi Kouao (Metz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Metz have a corner.
49' Kevin Danois (Auxerre) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
47' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
46' Koffi Kouao (Metz) was too forceful with his tackle and Marc Bollengier interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Auxerre have a free kick.
46' Benoit Tavenot has decided to substitute Jessy Deminguet and he is replaced by Alpha Toure (Metz).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
44' Romain Faivre (Auxerre) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards wide of the right post.
43' Sekou Mara (Auxerre) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
42' Rough tackle by Sadibou Sane (Metz). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Believe Munongo (Metz) commits a rough challenge and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.
39' Romain Faivre (Auxerre) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
38' Gauthier Hein (Metz) tries to find Habib Diallo, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
35' Gauthier Hein (Metz) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
34' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
33' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle as Romain Faivre (Auxerre) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
31' The possession of the ball – 64:36.
30' Sekou Mara (Auxerre) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
27' The goalkeeper dives to deny Kevin Danois (Auxerre), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
26' It looks like Clement Akpa (Auxerre) saw red with that tackle. Marc Bollengier won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
25' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
25' Gauthier Hein (Metz) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
23' Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) makes a strong challenge and Marc Bollengier blows for a foul.
21' Believe Munongo (Metz) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
20' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz).
19' Koffi Kouao (Metz) latches onto a cross and shoots from close-range, but Donovan Leon makes a terrific save to deny him.
17' A player from Metz commits a rough challenge. Marc Bollengier blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Auxerre are awarded a free kick.
15' Some patient build-up play from Metz as they look to unlock the defence.
10' Believe Munongo (Metz) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
10' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
8' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.
6' Today's referee Marc Bollengier rightly decides to book Koffi Kouao (Metz) for his harsh tackle.
6' Koffi Kouao (Metz) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Auxerre.
4' 0 - 1 OWN GOAL! Sadibou Sane (Metz) scores an unlucky own goal after he deflected a shot which went into his own net! 0:1.
3' Koffi Kouao (Metz) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Donovan Leon intercepts the ball.

1' What a poor attempt! Koffi Kouao (Metz) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes yards wide of the left post.
